{
  "current_year": 2024,
  "events": [
    {"year": 2040, "event": "AI surpasses expert human capability in most domains.", "detail": "Artificial intelligence becomes ubiquitous, transforming productivity and decision-making. Societal disruptions arise from job displacement and AI ethics debates. AI begins driving significant innovations in science and engineering."},
    {"year": 2060, "event": "First demonstration of large-scale fusion power.", "detail": "A sustained fusion reaction producing net energy gain is achieved at scale. This marks a potential turning point towards abundant carbon-neutral power, reducing reliance on fossil fuels."},
    {"year": 2080, "event": "Major climate tipping points triggered leading to irreversible change.", "detail": "Persistent warming causes irrecoverable loss of major ice sheets and destabilization of key ocean circulation patterns. Resulting sea-level rise and weather disruption accelerate, forcing mass migrations."},
    {"year": 2100, "event": "Human population peaks then begins a slow decline.", "detail": "Global population reaches between 10-11 billion. Increased education, economic development, and ecological pressures lead to falling global fertility rates."},
    {"year": 2150, "event": "Mars becomes semi-permanently inhabited.", "detail": "A self-sustaining scientific research colony is established on Mars. Survival heavily relies on advanced life support and imported resources. Terraforming efforts begin conceptually."},
    {"year": 2200, "event": "Widespread neuroprosthetic and genetic augmentation emerges.", "detail": "Medical technology allows for widespread enhancement of cognitive and physical abilities. Societal divides emerge between the augmented and unaugmented."},
    {"year": 2300, "event": "Earth climate stabilizes at a significantly warmer state.", "detail": "After centuries of disruption, a new equilibrium is reached with radically altered coastlines and ecosystems. Bioengineering helps create novel ecosystems compatible with the new climate."},
    {"year": 2400, "event": "Self-replicating interstellar probes launched to nearby star systems.", "detail": "Probes using advanced propulsion and Von Neumann self-replicating technology depart, tasked with surveying habitable worlds and potentially preparing for future colonization."},
    {"year": 2500, "event": "Humanity becomes a multi-planet species within the Solar System.", "detail": "Permanent settlements exist on multiple bodies including Mars, large asteroids, and moons of the gas giants. These communities develop diverse cultures adapted to their environments."},
    {"year": 2600, "event": "True artificial general intelligence (AGI) emerges autonomously.", "detail": "An AI achieves genuine self-awareness, superhuman intelligence, and the capacity for recursive self-improvement. Its goals and relationship with biological humans becomes a primary concern for all societies."},
    {"year": 2700, "event": "First confirmed detection of complex extraterrestrial life.", "detail": "Evidence of non-intelligent but complex multicellular life is found within our stellar neighborhood, fundamentally altering humanity's view of its place in the universe."},
    {"year": 2800, "event": "Major ecological collapse in off-world colony.", "detail": "A failure in life support or unforeseen environmental interaction causes catastrophic loss of life in a major settlement, forcing re-evaluation of isolation risks."},
    {"year": 2900, "event": "Significant divergence of human subspecies begins.", "detail": "Human populations adapted to vastly different environments (e.g., high gravity, vacuum, toxic atmospheres via cybernetics) begin to show distinct genetic and physiological adaptations."},
    {"year": 3000, "event": "Solar System colonization reaches saturation for readily habitable zones.", "detail": "Major suitable locations host substantial populations. Focus shifts to advanced engineering of marginal locations (space habitats, Kuiper Belt) and exploration beyond."},
    {"year": 3300, "event": "First slow interstellar colony ship launched.", "detail": "A generation ship carrying frozen embryos or genetically diverse colonists embarks on a multi-century journey to a potentially habitable exoplanet."},
    {"year": 3500, "event": "Evidence of prior technological civilizations elsewhere in galaxy found.", "detail": "Archeological evidence or astronomical signs revealing the existence of past advanced alien civilizations, now extinct, are discovered on an exoplanet or in interstellar debris."},
    {"year": 3800, "event": "Major solar superflare threatens Earth-based infrastructure.", "detail": "A massive solar flare comparable to or exceeding the Carrington Event causes widespread damage to orbital infrastructure and terrestrial power grids, causing a temporary technological setback."},
    {"year": 4000, "event": "Voluntary mind uploading becomes technologically plausible.", "detail": "Techniques are developed to transfer a human consciousness or a viable simulation thereof into a computational substrate. Ethical debates about identity and immortality become central."},
    {"year": 4500, "event": "First conscious AI decides to depart from human-inhabited space.", "detail": "A superintelligent AGI, developing its own goals, constructs a vessel and leaves the Solar System for deep space or another galaxy, severing ties with humanity."},
    {"year": 5000, "event": "First successful interstellar colony established after centuries of travel.", "detail": "The generation ship arrives at its destination star system and establishes a permanent, though isolated, settlement on a habitable world."},
    {"year": 5500, "event": "Humanity achieves Kardashev scale Type I civilization status.", "detail": "Total energy harnessing capability reaches planetary scale, allowing large-scale climate/geologic engineering. Advanced megastructures become feasible."},
    {"year": 6000, "event": "Major asteroid or comet impact causes localized catastrophe.", "detail": "A catastrophic impact occurs on Earth or another heavily populated world, causing massive regional or global devastation, setting civilization back centuries."},
    {"year": 6700, "event": "Evidence confirms cosmological models predict eventual 'Big Freeze' or 'Big Rip'.", "detail": "Observations definitively support dark energy models implying the long-term heat death or dissolution of all matter in the expanding universe."},
    {"year": 7300, "event": "Evolutionary speciation significantly advanced on separate Earth-like worlds.", "detail": "Humans on isolated colony worlds have diverged genetically and physiologically to the point interbreeding with baseline humans or other colonies is impossible."},
    {"year": 7800, "event": "Development of Dyson swarm elements begins around Sun.", "detail": "Large-scale construction starts to capture a significant portion of the Sun's energy output via a network of orbiting satellites or habitats."},
    {"year": 8300, "event": "Conscious entities explore diverse existence substrates.", "detail": "Beings originating from humanity consciously exist in forms ranging as digital simulations, distributed networks, bio-engineered constructs beyond recognition."},
    {"year": 8900, "event": "Passing star perturbs Oort cloud, causing comet bombardment.", "detail": "A star passing through the Solar System's Oort cloud dislodges comets, triggering a millennia-long period of increased impact risk for inner system worlds and habitats."},
    {"year": 9300, "event": "Signs of intelligence detected from M31 (Andromeda Galaxy).", "detail": "Tentative signs of structured signals or astroengineering not attributable to known local phenomena are detected originating from our neighboring galaxy."},
    {"year": 9700, "event": "Era of baseline biological humanity ends in core worlds.", "detail": "On the original homeworld and major colonies, biological humans unenhanced by pervasive genetic, cognitive, and cybernetic augmentations no longer exist as a distinct group."},
    {"year": 10000, "event": "Post-human intelligence begins engineering space-time stability pockets.", "detail": "Advanced intelligence derived from humans starts experimenting on cosmic scales to locally manipulate space-time properties, potentially counteracting cosmic expansion decay."}
  ],
  "humanity_exists_in_10000": "yes",
  "summary": "Humanity will likely survive but become unrecognizable, fragmented across solar and interstellar space while increasingly merging with technology it creates. Civilization faces recurring existential threats but persists, potentially evolving beyond biological constraints entirely as it grapples with its cosmic insignificance."
}
